assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: updated third-tab Planet interaction concept for PORTAL FITNESS.
Input 1 old Planet interaction board: reference only for functional information and globe style. Input 2 latest home: authority for charcoal dark green cards, restrained pale lime primary controls, typography and polished mobile app language.
Create a NEW landscape 3:2 high-resolution board with THREE fully visible large mobile phones, matching premium visual quality of latest home. Title Chinese exactly "生态页优化 · 球体成为视觉中心", upper-right "PORTAL FITNESS", small "交互示意 · 示例数据". Dark charcoal subtly textured backdrop, thin pale lime arrows below phones, minimal decoration. Mature modern sport-tech natural game art, light realism, not cute, not cyberpunk neon.
CRITICAL REMOVE: NO human figures, NO human faces, NO portrait avatars, NO companion banner anywhere on these Planet screens. The globe itself is the only hero image. No faces even icons. Planet tab central content should be clean and unobscured. Use line icons for controls.
Improve globe: a COMPLETE round spherical world with continuous curved ocean/continents, clear hemisphere silhouette, not a floating flat island. Natural daylight makes terrain readable against dark UI; layered slate mountain ridges at western side, limited pale high latitude ice cap, deep blue ocean and teal shallow coasts, connected river valley, distinct clustered forest and meadow, some dry ochre inland region. Mountains rise modestly, not a spiky pinecone. Thin sparse clouds at limb only, no opaque cloud blanket, no magical decorative rings. SAME recognizable world across views, same main mountain / river / ice anchors. Artistic detail consistent with reference, tidy readable shape.
PHONE 1 caption "01 球体全貌": header "My Planet", subtitle "A world inspired by your body data.", small "LV.5" unobtrusive. Big round globe centered in large interaction viewport using most width and about half usable screen height. Right edge stack small outline rotate / plus / minus / Reset controls, outside important globe features. Two or three tiny region markers with compact dark labels "Mountain Belt", "Deep Ocean", "Polar Ice", avoid clutter. Under globe one fine text line "Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom". NO old companion/portrait strip. Below 2x2 compact metric cards "Muscle 32.8 kg", "Water 58.3%", "Bone 3.1 kg", "Body fat 18.7%" with minimal mountain/water/ice/climate icons. Bottom Home / Train / Planet / Body / Me, Planet highlighted pale lime.
PHONE 2 caption "02 点击区域 · 查看详情": same header and globe slightly higher, same world angle. Selected Mountain Belt has subtle thin pale lime contour and small marker; do not fill whole land lime. Bottom sheet occupies lower third: "Mountain Belt", compact stat "Muscle · 32.8 kg", short copy "An artistic link between your data and this landscape.", lime "Focus region", quiet "Close details". Globe remains visible above sheet, no face. Nav remains at bottom Planet selected.
PHONE 3 caption "03 聚焦地貌 · 返回全貌": close orbital view of SAME mountain ridge and connected river coast, not first-person ground view, natural forest scale and rock strata visible. Header back chevron and "Mountain Belt". No character. Small bottom translucent information panel "Mountain Belt", "Muscle · 32.8 kg", one simple line "Explore the shape of your world.", wide outline or lime restrained button "Back to globe". No duplicate Focus action. No avatar, no reward, no XP numbers, no medical claims, no city.
Footer small Chinese path "旋转球体 → 选择区域 → 聚焦观察 → 返回全貌", note "地貌与指标为艺术映射示意". Keep phone controls and text legible, accurate English, safe area visible, not cropped, no loading phone wasting overview.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: homepage AI fitness agent entry + conversation interaction board for PORTAL FITNESS, continuing latest approved dark urban-comic fitness app style.
Use referenced latest home as layout and style authority. NEW landscape 3:2 high-resolution board with THREE large complete phones. Title Chinese exactly "首页新增 · AI 健身助手", top-right PORTAL FITNESS, small "交互示意 · 示例对话". Charcoal black green, pale lime CTA, clean white typography, fine borders and rounded cards. Match mature sporty lightly realistic urban American comic companion Maya in home only, brown ponytail, black technical sportswear, no real photos, no chibi, no neon overload. The agent uses a small abstract chat-bubble/orbit icon, not a human portrait. No extra sixth tab.
PHONE1 caption "01 首页 · AI 对话入口": Header "Hey, Alex", line "Let's keep going today." Directly under greeting insert a COMPACT full-width slim outlined utility strip, distinctive pale lime abstract chat icon left, readable "AI Coach", secondary smaller "Ask about your workout", chevron right. This is a prominent easy-to-find entry, not a floating button blocking content. Below preserve EXACT FOUR original modules in same order, enough visible: "My Planet" "LV.5" "320 / 800 XP" globe thumbnail right; "Today's plan" "3 tasks · 1 completed" lime "View plan", Maya companion half body right; "History" "This week · 3/5" seven small day markers first three checked; "Body overview" compact 2x2 "Muscle 32.8 kg", "Water 58.3%", "Bone 3.1 kg", "Body fat 18.7%". First two cards gently shortened so all four modules and nav stay readable, don't remove content or make microtype. Bottom Home / Train / Planet / Body / Me with Home selected.
PHONE2 caption "02 对话首页 · 健身辅助": header back chevron, abstract lime chat icon, "AI Coach", small "Fitness assistant". Calm chat landing centered upper middle with abstract chat logo, heading "How can I help today?", secondary "Let's work with your plan." Below one small context chip "Using: Today's plan" and subtle link "View context". THREE spacious quick-prompt outlined rounded rows "Review today's plan", "Explain an exercise", "Adjust my workout" each with simple icon and arrow. Below enough open space for future conversation. At bottom fixed composer "Ask about your workout..." and lime send arrow button. No bottom tabbar in full-screen chat. NO people or avatars in chat screens.
PHONE3 caption "03 建议草案 · 确认后保存": same full-screen AI Coach header. Same small context chip "Using: Today's plan". User right bubble "I only have 15 minutes today." Agent left with small abstract icon: "I can draft a shorter version of today's workout. Review it before saving." Below structured card clearly labeled "Suggested draft", title "Strength training", change "20 min → 15 min", small "For today only", three rows "Warm-up 3 min", "Strength 9 min", "Cool-down 3 min". Main button in the card "Review plan" opens proposal preview; beneath explicit small label "Your plan hasn't changed yet." NO automatic saved toast, NO auto training-start button, NO Apply without preview. Composer fixed at bottom same as phone2, with ample spacing so it never covers reply/card.
Footer concise Chinese workflow "首页入口 → 对话辅助 → 查看建议草案 → 确认保存到今日计划". This is a static concept, not actual model output. Keep accurate legible labels, no cropping, no API names/backend internals/pricing/premium, no heart rate or fabricated sensor data. Show a functional companion agent able to understand plan context and propose changes, restrained design friendly to both young men and women.
